App passcode reset is passcode_forgotten; changing a card PIN is change_pin; too many wrong PIN attempts is pin_blocked.
Lost phone or app access on a new device is lost_or_stolen_phone; stolen physical card is lost_or_stolen_card; unauthorized card/account use is compromised_card.
Receiving external money or salary is receiving_money; bank transfer into the account is transfer_into_account; adding money by debit/credit card is topping_up_by_card.
Supported cards/currencies for adding money is supported_cards_and_currencies; account or holding support for fiat currencies is fiat_currency_support.

Receiving external money or salary is receiving_money; bank transfer into the account is transfer_into_account; adding money by debit/credit card is topping_up_by_card.
